name: Datasette
description: Explore the SQLite databases in your workspace with Datasette (datasette.io), launched locally and embedded as a panel on the Cate canvas. Resolves a Datasette install on this machine (datasette on PATH, uvx, or pipx) and points it at the .db/.sqlite files found in the workspace.
